entities.summary: St Michael's Church is a late medieval Lutheran stone church in Finström in Åland Islands. The church, dedicated to Saint Michael, represents a significant example of late medieval ecclesiastical architecture in the Åland archipelago. According to research conducted by Markus Hiekkanen, the construction of the nave can be precisely dated to the period between 1445 and 1460, with stylistic parallels evident in contemporary ecclesiastical structures throughout Southwest Finland and Uusimaa region.
